allocator_0xfffffff0082f34a8.interpretation: OSMetaClass MetaClass::alloc instantiation - the ASCWrapV6 class instance WAS allocated at t=3.3s during early IOKit matching

init_0xfffffff0082f4108.interpretation: The allocated instance never reached init - the IOService matching chain stopped between allocation and initialization

start_0xfffffff00aad7da0.interpretation: Confirmed by the 57ZZ ascwrap-vtables artifact: ASCWrapV6 start_target is exactly this address (inherited A7IOP::start, owner=kernel). Never invoked.

root_cause_candidates: 1. IOService matching allocated the instance but the probe/attach cycle rejected it (e.g. provider power state, plane attach failure) and released it without init.

2. The single allocation is the class-registration self-test, not a personality match - and the real personality match never fired. The x2=0x40 arg suggests an OSMetaClass internal call, not IOService matching.
3. The matching fired but was immediately cancelled.
decisive_next_probe: Break at the CALLER of the ASCWrap allocator (capture LR at the allocator hit). If LR is in IOService matching code (kernel TEXT_EXEC), the personality match fired and failed downstream. If LR is in OSMetaClass registration code, the allocation was a class self-test and the personality never matched.
